summary: Website project on Internet Computer with Internet Identity login; add an owner-only admin view to see all users who have logged in (by principal ID) while keeping existing site unchanged.
architectural_notes: Use Internet Identity only; no custom registration fields required.
Store and display a list of unique user principal IDs that have authenticated.
Restrict visibility of the user list to the site owner/admin only.

existing_features.title: Implement a frontend Internet Identity login tracker that calls the backend tracking method once per Internet Identity login session, without modifying any immutable files.
Extend the existing owner/admin-only UI to display a table of all Internet Identity principals that have logged in, visible only to the site owner/admin, while keeping existing site behavior intact.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add Internet Identity login tracking and an owner-only admin view listing all users who have logged in (principal IDs), without changing other site behavior
Add backend support to record Internet Identity logins by principal ID whenever a user authenticates with Internet Identity.
Add a backend admin-only query endpoint that returns the list of Internet Identity login records (principal IDs and associated timestamps/count), accessible only to the site owner/admin.

projectName: Track Internet Identity logins and show owner-only list of logged-in principals
